config.wynn_weapon_viewer.title: Wynn Weapon Bigger Configuration
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.enabled: Enable or disable the Wynn Weapon Bigger mod
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.scale.t: Set the scale of the zoomed item (0.1 to 1.0)
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.alignme: Set the horizontal alignment of the zoomed item
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.xOffset: Set the horizontal offset of the zoomed item
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.yOffset: Set the vertical offset of the zoomed item
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.showTog: Show a message when toggling the item zoom
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.showIte: Show the zoomed item inside a Wynncraft-style card with its stats. Off: just the zoomed item, with its name, roll and badges floating below it
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.idleAni: Animation while hovering over an item
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.cardIdl: Also play the idle animation on the model inside the item card
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.cardSta: Item text cascades in line by line (about a quarter second), on the item card and under the floating item. Off: the text just appears
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.appearD: Delay before the item preview appears
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.showIte: Show item name, description and stats below the preview
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.itemNam: Show the item name above the preview instead of below
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.enableU: Enable zoom for unidentified Wynncraft items
config.wynn_weapon_viewer.option.enableC: Enable zoom for Corkian Amplifiers and related items
